POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a High criticality Server). Only a Security Administrator may create assets. Required: asset_name, asset_type, ip_address, department, owner_id, criticality_level. Returns 201 with the new asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Critical Database). Security Administrator only. Returns 201 with the new asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Medium criticality Workstation). Security Administrator only. Returns 201 with the new asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Network Device with status Under Maintenance). Optional fields such as operating_system are left out and stored as null. Security Administrator only. Returns 201. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Low criticality Cloud Resource). Optional fields location and operating_system are left out. Security Administrator only. Returns 201. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Validation test: the ip_address 999.1.1.1 is not a valid IP address, so the asset is rejected with 400 and a clear message. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Validation test: the asset_type Toaster is not one of the allowed types (Server, Workstation, Database, Application, Network Device, Cloud Resource), so the request is rejected with 400. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Authentication test: the request is sent with no Authorization header, so it is rejected with 401 (Authentication required). Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Authorization test: a Regular User token is valid but this role has no access to asset APIs, so the request is rejected with 403. The violation is written to the audit log. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

PUT /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Updates asset_name, owner_id, department, criticality_level and/or status of an existing asset. Security Administrator only. The new owner must be an existing user. Returns 200 with the updated asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Returns one asset by id, including its owner name and its related_incidents and related_vulnerabilities lists. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Used here to show the asset after the update. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/AdamYahya. Returns every registered asset with its details, criticality level and status. Allowed for Security Administrator and Auditor only (an Analyst gets 403). Implemented by: Adam Yahya
GET /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Error test: asset 9999 does not exist, so the service returns 404 with the message Asset not found. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?asset_name=... Searches assets by name. The text can match part of the name and is not case sensitive. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?asset_type=... Searches assets by exact asset type (for example Database). Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?ip_address=... Searches assets by exact IP address. The address is validated first. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?department=... Searches assets by department. The text can match part of the department name. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?criticality_level=... Searches assets by exact criticality level (Low, Medium, High or Critical). Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

DELETE /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Removes an asset. Security Administrator only: any other role gets 403 and the attempt is logged. Returns 200 on success, 404 if the asset does not exist, and 409 if incidents or vulnerabilities still reference it. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

item.name: Service 3 - Incident Management
item.description: Incident reporting, scoped retrieval, HTTP-validated analyst assignment, lifecycle and investigation notes. Set actual IDs and role tokens before sending requests.

request.description: Report an incident as a Regular User (or Administrator). All six body fields are required; use real reporter_id and asset_id. A Regular User must report as themselves. Returns 201 with an Open incident; copy data.incident_id into incident_id. Severity: Low, Medium, High or Critical. Missing reporter/asset returns 404. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Return all incident metadata (200). Administrator or Auditor only; an empty database returns data: []. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Return one incident and its stored investigation_notes (200). Administrator/Auditor may read any; Regular User only their reports; Analyst only assigned incidents. Missing resources return 404 to Administrator/Auditor; inaccessible or missing resources return 403 to scoped users. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator only. Service 3 forwards this Bearer token to Service 1 GET /users over real HTTP before starting a write transaction. Service 1 must be reachable at USERS_SERVICE_URL (default port 5001). Requires an existing Active Security Analyst: absent user 404, wrong role/inactive user 400, dependency unavailable/invalid response 503. Success 200 atomically updates assignment, creates an Incident Assignment notification and records audit entries. Repeating the same analyst produces no duplicate notification. Use Service 8 recipient history to obtain the generated notification_id. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator or assigned Analyst. Returns 200 when advancing exactly one step: Open -> Under Investigation -> Mitigated -> Resolved -> Closed. Set incident_status to the next value for each call. Skipping/repeating/reversing a transition returns 409. Resolved sets resolution_date; Closed retains it. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator or assigned Analyst. Required nonblank note_content; returns 201 with server-generated note_id, caller analyst_id and timestamp. Retrieve the incident to see the persisted note. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

item.name: Service 8 - Notification Service
item.description: Prefixed notification API: creation, recipient history, retrieval, read acknowledgement, search and administrator deletion. Samples target the analyst recipient.

request.description: Administrator only. All five fields are required. Returns 201 with Unread status and null read_date for the existing recipient (404 if absent). This sample targets analyst_id, so the Analyst token can retrieve and read it. Copy data.notification_id into notification_id. Types: Incident Assignment, Security Alert, System Notification, Threat Alert, Vulnerability Alert; severities Low, Medium, High, Critical. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": {{analyst_id}},
  "title": "Security alert",
  "message": "Review the suspicious login on the monitored server.",
  "notification_type": "{{notification_type}}",
  "severity_level": "{{severity_level}}"
}

request.description: Return the recipient notification history (200), including automatic Service 3 assignment notifications. An existing recipient with no notifications returns data: []; a nonexistent recipient returns 404 to an authorized caller. Regular Users and Analysts may read only their own history; Administrator/Auditor may read any. Copy the desired notification_id from this response. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Return one notification (200), including status, created_at and read_date. Regular Users and Analysts may read only their own notifications; Administrator/Auditor may read any. Missing records return 404 to Administrator/Auditor; inaccessible or missing records return 403 to scoped users. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator or owning Analyst/Regular User; Auditor is forbidden. No request body. Returns 200 with status Read and the first read_date; repeating the request preserves that timestamp. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator, Analyst or Auditor. Combine recipient, type, severity and read status using AND; at least one filter is required. Returns 200 with matching notifications or data: []. Analysts are restricted to their own results. notification_status accepts Unread/Read. For automatic assignment notifications set notification_type to Incident Assignment. Empty, repeated, unknown or invalid filters return 400. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator only. Returns 200; subsequent administrator retrieval returns 404. Deletion preserves the recipient user. Other roles receive 403. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

item.name: Service 9 - Security Playbooks and Response Automation
item.description: Playbooks, ordered response actions, assignment/progress, execution history and deletion. These APIs record action execution; they do not run shell commands.

request.description: Administrator only. Four required body fields; returns 201 with server-controlled created_by/created_at and empty response_actions/action_history. Copy data.playbook_id into playbook_id. Create another playbook by changing the name/category/severity when needed. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator, Analyst or Auditor. Returns 200 with all playbook metadata, or data: [] when none exist. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

item.name: Retrieve ordered actions and execution history

request.description: Administrator, Analyst or Auditor. Returns 200 with metadata, response_actions sorted by step_number and chronological action_history snapshots. Missing playbook returns 404. Retrieve after status updates to inspect execution history. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator or Analyst. Requires action_description and positive integer step_number, unique within this playbook (duplicate 409). Returns 201 with Pending status, no assignee and null completion_date; copy data.action_id into action_id. Change step_number and description for additional actions; retrieval sorts by step number, even if created out of order. Missing playbook returns 404. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator or Analyst. Returns 200; at least one of status, assigned_user_id or completion_date is required. This body assigns an existing Active analyst and applies action_status (Pending, In Progress or Completed). Set Completed to automatically record today in UTC, or add completion_date in YYYY-MM-DD format for an explicit nonfuture date. Explicit null date for Completed, future dates and dates on noncompleted actions return 400. assigned_user_id may be null to unassign; absent user returns 404. Reopening clears completion_date; unchanged updates preserve history. Missing action returns 404. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.

Administrator only. Returns 200 and cascades deletion of live response actions. Execution history and audit records remain in the database. Subsequent playbook retrieval returns 404; other users/resources remain intact. Requires a valid Service 1 Bearer token; missing/invalid authentication returns 401 and forbidden roles return 403. Invalid inputs return 400.
